title: Decompose, Look, and Reason: Reinforced Latent Reasoning for VLMs
abstract: arXiv:2604.07518v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Vision-Language Models often struggle with complex visual reasoning due to the visual information loss in textual CoT. Existing methods either add the cost of tool calls or rely on localized patch-based embeddings that are insufficient to extract semantics in multi-step reasoning. We propose "Decompose, Look, and Reason" (DLR), a reinforced latent reasoning framework that dynamically decomposes queries into textual premises, extracts premise-conditioned continuous visual latents, and deduces answers through grounded rationales. We introduce a three-stage training pipeline and propose a novel Spherical Gaussian Latent Policy, to enable effective exploration in the latent space. Extensive experiments on vision-centric benchmarks show that DLR consistently outperforms strong baselines, including text-only, interleaved multimodal CoT, and latent reasoning methods, while providing superior stepwise interpretability.

translated_title: 分解、观察与推理：面向视觉语言模型的强化潜在推理
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型由于文本思维链中存在视觉信息丢失，常常难以处理复杂的视觉推理任务。现有方法要么增加了工具调用的成本，要么依赖于局部化的基于图像块的嵌入，这些嵌入不足以在多步推理中提取语义。我们提出了“分解、观察与推理”（DLR），这是一个强化潜在推理框架，能够动态地将查询分解为文本前提，提取以前提为条件的连续视觉潜在表示，并通过有依据的推理链推导答案。我们引入了一个三阶段训练流程，并提出了新颖的球面高斯潜在策略，以实现潜在空间中的有效探索。在以视觉为中心的基准测试上的大量实验表明，DLR 持续优于强大的基线方法，包括纯文本方法、交错多模态思维链和潜在推理方法，同时提供了卓越的逐步可解释性。
tldr: 本文提出DLR强化潜在推理框架，通过将查询动态分解为文本前提、提取条件化的连续视觉潜在表示，并配合三阶段训练流程与新颖的球面高斯潜在策略，显著提升了视觉语言模型多步视觉推理的性能与逐步可解释性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DLR, a reinforced latent reasoning framework that dynamically decomposes queries into textual premises, extracts premise-conditioned continuous visual latents, and introduces a three-stage training pipeline with a novel Spherical Gaussian Latent Policy to significantly improve multi-step visual reasoning performance and stepwise interpretability in vision-language models.
